name: Suspension Knee Tuck
steps: Secure your feet in the low cradles and place your hands under your shoulders.
Press up into a high plank with hips level and abdomen braced.
Contract your abs and hip flexors to pull both knees smoothly forward toward your chest while keeping your shoulders stacked over your wrists.
Extend your legs slowly back out to the rigid plank position without letting your lower back sag.
tips: Stop any pendulum swing of the straps cleanly at the extended plank before starting the next repetition.
Keep your hips level as your legs straighten rather than letting them drop toward the floor.
